text: For your records, no action needed: the seat count for the 2026 renewal at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 261 seats.
reply_text:
I saved Ilse's note as a fact in the shared memory: the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is for 261 seats. The note records that it came from her, in #north-team, at 09:00 on 2026-10-14. I also replied to her in that thread to say it's noted.

A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to keep and share with the account team. Nothing else needed doing.

There are two limits on the memory system. It can only spot exact duplicates, so if the same fact gets saved later in different words, there will be two copies. And the bot's current access blocks some memory operations; only the memory's owner can change that, by running `gbrain doctor --only grant_new_ops_available --json` on the server.
